title: Karbobala me hogaye bedaad kya naye
body:
KARBOBALA MEIN HOGAYE BEDAAD KYA NAYE – FARYAAD YA ALI
TA HASHR YAAD AAYEGI ASGHAR KI TISHNAGI – FARYAAD YA ALI
Khakar gale pa teer-e-sitam muskura diya – Sab ko rula diya
Kya zulm ki udaai hai besheer ne hansi – Faryad Ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Bache ki yaad aayi hai maa beqarar hai – Aur ashkbaar hai
Har ek ki goad dhoondti phirti hai dil jali – Faryad Ya Ali
Soncha ye hoga maa ne ke Shah leke jayenge – Pani pilayenge
Teer-e-sitam se haye bujhi hai ye tishnagi – Faryad Ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Saidaniyon mein shor hai faryad-o-aah hai – Haalat tabah hai
Shabbir leke jaate hai maiyat sagheer ki – Faryad Ya Ali
Asgher ko dafn kar chuke maqtal mein bekafan – Bano ka gulbadan
Eimaa’n ki raah mein thi yahi nazr aakhri – Faryad Ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim bhi nauha karta hai karta hai shor-o-shain – Dil ko nahi hai chain
Matam Ali ke laal ka hai maqsad-e-dili – Faryad Ya Ali
